caseNameFull: Storer v. Brown, Secretary of State of California and Frommhagen v. Brown, Secretary of State of California

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. N. D. Cal. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 410 U. S. 965.] Motion of appellants in No. 72-812 for divided argument granted. It is ordered that Paul N. Halvonik, Esquire, and Joseph Remcho, Esquire, be permitted to present oral argument in the consolidated cases. Motion of appellant in No. 72-6050 to argue orally pro se denied.
